issueList.title: Root /manifest.json returns 404 (PWA path is /projects/manifest.json)
issueList.impact: Install prompts / crawlers hitting root manifest fail
issueList.recommended_fix: Add redirect from /manifest.json to /projects/manifest.json or document canonical path only

issueList.title: PWA manifest has empty icons array
issueList.impact: Add-to-home-screen shows generic/missing icon on Android/iOS
issueList.recommended_fix: Populate manifest.icons with 192/512 maskable PNGs and verify URLs

issueList.title: CLS above 0.1 on Chromium 1366x768
